For the Asymmetric Shawl Collar, 5 cm wide shown in the image, the geometry is significantly narrower and more elongated than a classic tuxedo shawl. The red drafting lines show an offset center roll line, creating an asymmetric visual balance while maintaining a continuous shawl curve.

Visual Analysis

The image shows:

Finished shawl width: 5 cm
Narrow fashion shawl collar
Continuous roll without notch or peak
Slightly asymmetric front edge
Long V-opening
Pointed front termination
Chinese text near the bottom that appears to be a drafting note

x2a2+y2b2=1\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1

This produces the long narrow silhouette shown.
